threads.Text: [Q] Key scoring decision: this replaces the current blended coverage score. Does separating discovery improvement from handoff non-regression match the evidence you want before dogfood?

Anchor.selected_text: Split promotion semantics: source-question coverage must improve on a majority of cases; plan-to-research coverage becomes a no-regression guardrail.

threads.Text: [Q] Assumed we should run six fresh agent tasks manually from the frozen manifest and avoid adding an orchestration runtime. Veto this if reproducibility requires a project-owned runner.

Anchor.context_after: Store research, plan, sidecars, semantic-pass logs, and failure status per run.

threads.Author: codex
threads.Text: [Q] Human-owned go/no-go: the plan uses one blinded reviewer across three cases. Confirm that is enough for this pilot, or ask for a second independent preference judge.
threads.SectionPath: Plan: credible pilot for autonomous research convergence > Desired End State

Anchor.selected_text: The human can inspect the bundle in `comments view`, decide whether the evidence earns dogfood, and leave a durable signoff.
Anchor.context_before: Automated checks can reproduce every derived metric.

threads.Author: codex
threads.Text: [S] One bounded dogfood task validates operability but not generality. Widen only if you want promotion to require more than the fixed three-case pilot plus one live task.
threads.SectionPath: Plan: credible pilot for autonomous research convergence > Implementation Phases > Phase 4 — perform one bounded dogfood run
